name: ruvos-google-chat
description: Search spaces, read and send Google Chat messages via Google Chat MCP. Uses static Google OAuth (your chatsAuth client) — Configure GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / SECRET after install.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.title: Google OAuth Client ID
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from GCP project chatsAuth (Web application). Redirect URIs must include http://localhost:8787/callback and https://www.cursor.com/agents/mcp/oauth/callback

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret for that same Web client
